description: Run Seer AI root cause analysis on a Sentry issue and return the root cause, affected code locations, and a suggested code fix. Returns an existing analysis at once; a new one takes minutes, so call it only when the user asks for Seer or a fix, or the issue details do not show the cause. Does not support metric alert issues.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

name: analyze_issue_with_seer
title: Analyze Issue with Seer
